title: Beef & Mushroom Stroganoff
description: Rich, creamy, and anchored by mushrooms — a classic dinner that works for weeknights or company.

ingredients.notes: to serve; or substitute wholegrain toast

method.instruction: Toss beef strips with paprika, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
Heat olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add beef in batches and cook for 2–3 minutes until browned. Remove and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, add the sliced onion and cook for 2–3 minutes until softened.
Add mushrooms and cook for 3–4 minutes until golden and tender.
Add beef stock and Worcestershire sauce. Bring to a simmer and cook for 3–4 minutes to reduce slightly.
Return beef and any collected juices to the pan. Stir through.
Reduce heat to low. Stir in sour cream gently and heat through without boiling — boiling will split the sauce.
Meanwhile, steam green beans until just tender, about 3–4 minutes.
Serve stroganoff over egg noodles or wholegrain toast, garnished with fresh chives and green beans on the side.

notes.title: Temperature Control
notes.content: Keep the heat gentle once the sour cream goes in. Boil it and the sauce will split — there is no fixing that.

notes.title: Red Wine Addition
notes.content: Using dry red wine is optional — it adds richness but is not required for a classic stroganoff flavour. Add 60 ml with the stock if desired.

notes.title: Recipe Origin
notes.content: This Beef & Mushroom Stroganoff is adapted from a recipe originally published by Taste.com.au.
